supporting_pages.title: "Configure data RBAC for data tables \_|\_ Google Security Operations \_\
evidence_snippets: The following considerations apply when updating a data table: Removing scopes from a data table is only allowed if all existing rules that use the data table remain functional after the change.
Another way of looking at this is from the perspective of a data table: Scoped data tables with selected can be accessed by specific users or rules that have matching scopes.
A scoped user can remove a scope from a data table, which can cause other scoped users to lose access.
